why: Measures mobility through the INTACT board rather than through solid-only space. `versus-board.ts` gates egress on destructible-free connectivity for a stated reason -- a player may mine through a destructible, so the solid layout is the topology no play can change -- and this module follows it. Under the mutation arena-02, whose two halves are joined only through destructible walls, reports its spawn pair as having no route at all: the pair falls out of `spawnPairs`, `pathMin` collapses to its empty-list fallback of 0, and a board designed around blowing a hole in the centre barrier reads as two spawns sitting on top of each other. Pins that mine-gated is reported as mine-gated and never as unreachable.
killedBy: mapgen quality measures: each measure moves when its cause is introduced destructible-only separation reads as mine-gated, never as unreachable
